title: Scheduled maintenance – NBN services in Penrith and Glebe (NSW)
current_summary: The scheduled maintenance for NBN services in the Penrith and Glebe areas (NSW) is complete. The work finished at 7:00 am AEDT on Wed 21 Oct 2026, within the planned window. Services may have been affected during the window.

cause.reason: Planned network provider migration of services

updates.content:
We will be conducting scheduled network work with a provider that may affect NBN services in the Penrith and Glebe areas (NSW). The maintenance window is Wed 21 Oct 2026 from 12:00 am to 7:00 am AEDT. During this time, some services may experience brief interruptions.

We will monitor the work and provide updates if anything changes. If your service remains offline after 7:00 am AEDT, please power-cycle your modem/router and contact us.

The scheduled maintenance for NBN services in the Penrith and Glebe areas (NSW) started at 12:00 am AEDT on Wed 21 Oct 2026. Some services may experience interruptions while the migration is carried out, and the work is scheduled to finish by 7:00 am AEDT. If your service is still offline after 7:00 am AEDT, please power-cycle your modem/router and contact us.

The scheduled maintenance for NBN services in the Penrith and Glebe areas (NSW) was completed at 7:00 am AEDT on Wed 21 Oct 2026. Services should now be back to normal. If your service is still offline, please power-cycle your modem/router and contact us.
